ghidra.fallback_reason: The stock and candidate exports assign different primary names to the same section-relative GPIO data binding and pointer-table labels; shared-binding normalization accepts only those proven equal offsets. This compiler-sensitive AArch64 GPIO/pinctrl helper may also expose bounded synthetic symbol or type-rendering artifacts; all narrow fallbacks remain subordinate to direct P-Code, Assembly/relocation, KCFI and Docker gates.
ghidra.fallback_evidence: Retain stock and candidate Ghidra exports, exact Assembly, KCFI, Joern and harness evidence. Shared bindings are accepted only for equal section-relative offsets; no binary or hardware gate may be waived by fallback.
